descriptionMarkdown:
This is Destiny.

Important: 
If you have any issues to start the ship, set the condition on the CONTROL PANEL to "OR" temporary.

Version 2.4:
- adjusted indicators to show low values correctly

Version 2.3:
- added "damage recieved" indicator
- adjusted iron distribution to better fuel optimalization
- added control panel label and further optimized engines control
- adjusted asteroid collectors for better ammo optimalization
- added 2 more laser towers
- added ON/OFF button for laser towers
- added indicators for ammo buffer
- remade engines/fuel controller

Starship properties:
Size: 93(w)x117(h)
Weight: 889t
Cargo: 19x
Thrusters: 5x
Tanks: 100K
Energy: ~10MW/420MJ
Turrets: 11x top,10x sides,6x rear-> 27x total + 5x top laser

- It's optimized for standard planet supply trips. 
- Tested and calibrated on trip between Nauvis and Gleba. 
- It's self sustain and prevents any overloads of asteroid collectors.
- Ship contains control panel where engines efficiency can be set.
- Ship contains indicator system for levels of energy,fuel,water and ammo.
- Ship contains blinking navigation lights.
- In future it can be upgraded for nuclear power.

© Designed by Velda
https://www.youtube.com/@VeldaGames/

My other ships:

Orion:

https://factorioprints.com/view/-P4oNjloO_WQswp5l7SP

Aurora:

https://factorioprints.com/view/-P4L5RqArOGPQiRcSyxW

Engines control on this ship is created by decider combinator which serves as the ship's control panel and is connected to fuel pumps. On the control panel you set number from 101 to 200. 101 means 99% efficiency, 105 means 95% efficiency, 120 means 80% etc. 
There is also a second number/condition there which reads velocity of the ship. The pumps will not providing fuel to the ship until the velocity reaches 15km/s and more. This can save some fuel during the start of the ship.

Ship was calibrated for default value 105 (95% efficiency,29% fuel consumption) which means low fuel consumption but also low speed. You can play with it but bear in mind that if you set it wrong, ship can suddenly stops or quickly consumes all of its fuel. 
With the default value 105 your fuel will NEVER dries out! So you can fly back and forth without waiting and without worrying about the ship's resources at all! This ship is about beauty and sources optimalization, not about the speed~ 

The only small waiting gaps on the planets are recommended for ammo replenishment, but it takes 0 - 1min depending on how many asteroids you met on your trip.

On the control panel you can also see ship's state - it shows detailed numbers for fuel,water,energy(A),velocity(V),ammo and damage(D) recieved.

EDIT: 
I done some more testing and it handles also 110-115 setup on the controller (which means almost double speed) without need to make longer stops for refueling, but you have to be lucky for asteroids. With setup 120 you will hit threshold where ship's fuel starts to drain fast. 
So all in all, 105-110 is the recommended value on the control panel to keep fuel in green numbers all the time.
